# sonarqube_application (Resource)

An application, aggregating projects. Requires Developer edition or above.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Applications require the Developer edition or higher.
resource "sonarqube_project" "api" {
  name    = "API"
  project = "example-api"
}

resource "sonarqube_project" "web" {
  name    = "Web"
  project = "example-web"
}

resource "sonarqube_application" "shop" {
  key         = "example-shop"
  name        = "Shop"
  description = "Everything the shop is built from."
  visibility  = "private"
  projects    = [sonarqube_project.api.project, sonarqube_project.web.project]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Application key.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `projects` (Set of String) Keys of the projects in the application. When omitted, membership is not managed.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags. When omitted, tags are not managed.
- `visibility` (String) `public` or `private`. Defaults to the server's default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_application.example 'example-shop'
```
